actions.action: Scratch the stalk bark to check if it is alive
If alive, cut stalk back to just above lowest green node
Brush soil away to check whether leafy plants are attached to old stem
Cut woody stalk at soil level with clean snips
Pinch healthy plants above second leaf pair once they have 3-4 pairs
Pinch off flower spikes as they appear
Check top 2-3 cm of soil and water only when dry
Make sure the pot has a drainage hole

reason: The answer recognises the woody old stalk but frames it as end-of-life rather than overgrowth needing pruning, yet its main advice (remove the stalk, pinch and harvest the young plants for bushiness) matches the fix that worked, and nothing is harmful.
